This project is a lightweight Atomic Nucleus Visualizer built with p5.js, vanilla JavaScript, and CSS.

## Key Features
- Interactive periodic table with 20 elements
- Real-time nucleus visualization with spinning protons and neutrons
- Pure p5.js canvas animations optimized for 60fps
- Responsive design that works on all devices
- Single-file deployment (no build process)
- Embeddable via iframe

## Project Structure
- /index.html - Main HTML structure and layout
- /style.css - Responsive CSS styling with modern gradients
- /elements.js - Element data and periodic table interaction logic
- /sketch.js - p5.js particle animation and physics
- /package.json - Optional development dependencies (live-server)

## Development Guidelines
- Keep it simple - no frameworks, no build process
- Use vanilla JavaScript for DOM manipulation
- p5.js only for canvas animations and particle physics
- Maintain 60fps performance on mobile devices
- Ensure cross-browser compatibility
- Focus on educational value and visual appeal
- Keep file sizes minimal for fast loading

## Animation Principles
- Protons (red) and neutrons (blue) in realistic nuclear arrangements
- Smooth orbital motion with slight wobble for organic feel
- Responsive canvas that scales with screen size
- Efficient particle system with proper cleanup
